from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BeginningCashBalance(BaseModel):
    """The beginning cash and cash equivalents balance from one company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company that filed this 10-Q report")
    beginning_cash_balance: float | None = Field(description="Beginning cash and cash equivalents balance amount")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of the amount - e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    period_start: str | None = Field(description="Period start date of the financial statement")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="Period end date of the financial statement")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text showing the cash balance line item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    beginning_cash_balances: list[BeginningCashBalance]
